**[P2] Preserve absence when calling the trace-ID helper**

`runtimeHeader` is `undefined` both when the context lacks `xRayTraceId` and when it exposes an authoritative empty carrier. This object literal always makes the property present, so `deriveExecutionTraceId` suppresses `_X_AMZN_TRACE_ID` on ordinary contexts while `xRayContextExtractor(info)` correctly uses it. The example can therefore return mismatched trace IDs, and its test skips that comparison when `runtimeHeader` is falsy. Track `"xRayTraceId" in context.lambdaContext`, omit the fourth argument/property when absent, and assert the environment-fallback path.
